# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository is feriados.dev open source: a self-hosted, Brazil-only holiday
API with no commercial flows.

Follow `AGENTS.md` for project rules. Use `docs/API_CONTEXT_FOR_AI.md` for the
domain model and `docs/AI_PLAYBOOK.md` for task workflows.

Do not suggest auth, billing, API keys, plans, quotas, checkout or Stripe.
Holiday data changes must be source-backed and narrowly scoped.
